{{Quote|I just received word, Sim—the clones have those clankers surrounded. This latest Separatist incursion will be contained within hours! Once they're done mopping up here, our boys can advance all the way to Ukio. Maybe in time to reopen the old kern route before the harvest. That would be a right boon.|Fond Dachris, to Sim Aloo during the Clone Wars|<ref name="Kernels Husks">{{StoryCite|story=Kernels and Husks|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}}</ref>}}
'''Ukio''' was a bountiful<ref name="Odyssey">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref> [[Agriworld|agrarian]] [[planet]] located in the [[Abrion sector]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Propaganda" /> connected by [[Hyperspace route|hyperlane]] to [[Rishi]] and [[Molavar]].<ref name="RO World Locations">{{SW|url=news/where-in-the-galaxy-are-the-worlds-of-rogue-one|text=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Rogue One''?|int=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Rogue One?}}</ref> Ukio also enjoyed a trade route with another argiworld, [[Noomis Riga]].<ref name="Kernels Husks" /> Its native inhabitants were the [[Ukian]]s. During the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic]], Ukio acted as a breadbasket of the [[Core Worlds]]<ref name="Propaganda" /> and overall Republic.<ref name="OF84">{{GermanFanCite|84|Database}}</ref> However, during the [[Separatist Crisis|Secessionist Movement]], the Ukians began to resent the Republic for not helping them enough. Eventually, Ukio joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Propaganda" />

The tensions between the Republic and Separatists resulted in the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Propaganda" /> With the conflict being fought by [[clone trooper]]s and [[battle droid]]s,<ref name="OF84" /> who cost their respective governments great deals of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]],<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> economically important planets like Ukio became targets.<ref name="OF84" /> During a [[Incursion on Noomis Riga|battle for Noomis Riga]], the farmer [[Fond Dachris]] hoped the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] would advance all the way to Ukio, thereby reopening a kernel trade route to Noomis Riga in time for their next harvest. Dachris would never live to see if he was right, however, as he was murdered by his neighbor [[Sim Aloo]] as part of Aloo's scheme to steal his farm.<ref name="Kernels Husks" />

Ultimately, despite it having joined the CIS before the war,<ref name="Propaganda" /> Ukio again became a granary for the Republic during the conflict.<ref name="OF84" /> In [[3 BBY]], [[Bix Caleen]] purchased three [[melon]]s fresh from Ukio at [[Samo's|a shop]] on [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?">{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}}</ref> After fleeing from the [[Battle of Scarif]]<ref name="Odyssey" /> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] ordered [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles]] to take her [[CR90 corvette]], ''[[Tantive IV]]'', to the planet [[Tatooine]]. In order to try and evade Imperial pursuit, Antilles followed no direct line and doubled back on himself during the journey, jumping first from the [[Scarif system]] to Ukio, and then on to [[Roon]].<ref name="Odyssey" />
